verdict.rationale: Texas SOS runs an online filing and search portal (SOSPortal), so a test or sandbox environment is a fair question, but the evidence documents no sandbox, test mode or non-production environment. Saving filings as drafts is a related feature, not isolated testing, and earns no credit. All documented searches and filings are live and fee-bearing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
